   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Aug 18, 2026 - Nov 13, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Chris Cagle_, Nov 13, 2026, 1/5: "I "was" really enjoying this app. I did the paid version of the trial and was very pleased, but decided the free version was all I needed. It has worked great for the last few months until this update. It refuses to update and the app is now unusable. I'm hoping this is resolved soon and not an attempt to remove free users."
            2. _Gabriel_, Nov 13, 2026, 1/5: "Hey, I opened it for the first time and it said new version for update. Then I clicked on the update button, which brought me to the Play Store. But in the Play Store, I saw that the app had no update, so I went back to the app. I uninstalled it and then redownloaded it, and it still did the same thing. I'm not sure what's causing this, but this immediately needs to be fixed. Because literally as soon as I joined, it already gave me a bug."
            3. _Paul Lapouge Dalbavie_, Aug 18, 2026, 1/5: "Much too expensive application which offers you a first month for 6€ but the next one what was my surprise to realize that the monthly subscription was then more than 70€, of course if I had not looked in detail on the Play Store it is impossible to know Despite it being a good application despite the recurring bugs, it is much too expensive for what it is"
